name: Fan-out tail latency calculator
blurb: A request fans out to N calls and waits for all of them. See how many requests are slow, and what percentile each call needs to meet your target.

inputs.label: Calls per request
inputs.description: How many calls one request makes and waits for: shards, backends, or one service called several times.

inputs.label: Each call is slow
inputs.description: The share of calls over your latency limit, such as 0.5%. Or the percentile at that limit: p99 means 1% of calls are over it.

inputs.label: Your target
inputs.description: The percentile you promise for the whole request, such as p99: 99 in 100 requests within the same limit.

inputs.label: Several dependencies (optional)
inputs.description: Leave this empty unless a request calls services with different tails. One per line: name, calls, share slow, as in pricing 20 0.5% or ads 1 5%. A list here replaces the first two inputs.

samples.label: The Tail at Scale: 100 servers at their p99
What p99 does each of 20 shards need?

input.dependencies:
cart 1 0.1%
pricing 20 0.5%
inventory 1 1%
tax 1 0.2%
shipping quotes 1 2%
payments 1 0.5%
fraud check 1 1%
user profile 1 0.1%
promotions 2 0.5%

recommendations 1 1%
session cache 3 0.1%
